name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 3 No 38

clue.text: Doctor has to treat many a fellow loaded with drink
Demeanour of singer holds an audience
Source of power denied a churchman
Burn dry content with apprehension
Drink, it’s said, is meant to have body
Fallen Renegade — novel by Lawrence
Treatment for bats flowing freely
Like Beatrice, a girl found by lawyer in naughty embrace
Fellow in church appears to sing
Trust administered church without a priest
A crazy person, Margaret, but spicy
Mean, for example, leaving resort —- Lyme Regis?
Clogs (not wood) included in footwear constitute a stumbling-block
Goddess is a term that could be applied to Diana
A pound off hair-style induces wild outbreak
Set apart to pocket a snooker ball?
Each child has a life to start on his own
His trade is said to be comparatively coarse
Thankless deserter given sanctuary by Dean
How it’s said the worm turned
Figure of a girl, neat and trim
Drug sends to bed one in nine
Country backward in some geriatric care
Former artist, leading light on the side
Priest upset by doctor? Rubbish!
Madness can arise during Christmas, before it’s over
